Title: [LSJ] Nehemiah and Visit from the Cappuchin

Messages.Author: Andreas Nusser
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ,

I have a question regarding the special ability of Nehemiah and Visit
from the Cappuchin.

Card Tests:

Nehemiah, 9, obt POT PRE SER TEM, True Brujah, 4, [LoB]

Independent: Nehemiah has 2 votes (titled). During your untap phase, you
may move up to two cards from your hand to the bottom of your library
(draw afterward). Nehemiah cannot use cards that require Celerity. Scarce.

Visit from the Capuchin, Master, R2 , [FN:R2]

Unique master. Put this card into play; put four counters on this card
from the blood bank. Your hand size is +X, where X is the number of
counters on this card. Each time you play or discard a card (except when
discarding down to your hand size), burn a counter from this card (do
not draw a replacement card). Burn this card when the last counter is
removed.

I play Visit form the Cappuchin and have 11 cards in my hand. In my next
untap phase I MOVE 2 cards on the bottom of my library.

Question: Do I redraw since the cards were just moved?

Thanks for your answer

Andreas

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andreas Nusser wrote:
> I play Visit form the Cappuchin and have 11 cards in my hand. In my next
> untap phase I MOVE 2 cards on the bottom of my library.
>
> Question: Do I redraw since the cards were just moved?

Yes. No counters were lost from Visit, so your hand size is still 11.
Draw back to 11.
